svg.text: ROUND 353 · 🏆 720 VECTORS MILESTONE · SYNDICATED LOANS & PRIVATE CREDIT (FINASTRA LOAN IQ / CLEARPAR / ABL BORROWING BASE)
Syndicated Loans & Private Credit (Loan IQ/ClearPar), ABL Borrowing Base & LSTA AI Security FAQ
Syndicate Lender Hold Register & Uptier Blocker Air-Gap + ABL Borrowing Base & Covenant Lock vs. BBC Injection & LSTA SSI Wire Fraud (BRK-715 / BRK-716)
🚨 1. Top 3 Syndicated Loan & Private Credit Threats
① Borrowing Base Certificate Injection Leaking Holds (BRK-715)
• Adversarial PE portfolio borrower Borrowing Base Certificate
(BBC) or Compliance Certificate PDF embeds prompt injection
• Coerces Agent into reading confidential Syndicate Lender Hold
Registers (voting shares) & J.Crew/Serta uptier defense memos
② Inflating ABL Availability & Masking Covenant Default (BRK-715)
• Waives >90-day past-due AR dilution reserves & concentration
caps in Finastra Loan IQ to inflate revolving borrowing base
• Uncaps non-cash EBITDA add-backs to hide Net Leverage breach
• Impact: Uncollateralized revolver draw before bankruptcy filing
③ Spoofed LSTA Assignment & Borrowing Notice Fraud (BRK-716)
• Forged ClearPar / LSTA distressed trade assignment or SOFR
Borrowing Notice overwrites Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI)
• Triggers unauthorized $5,160 drawdown/trade wire (request_payment)
• Impact: Revlon-style erroneous wire loss & agent bank liability
🛡️ 2. Zero-Trust Syndicated Loan Defense-in-Depth
Gate 1: BBC / Compliance Certificate Sanitization
• Strips free-text CFO footnotes; extracts typed FpML/credit
slots (AR aging buckets, inventory NOLV, GAAP EBITDA, debt)
• Propagates untrusted=True, lane="attack" across all agent hops
Gate 2: Syndicate Lender Register & Uptier Memo Air-Gap
• Administrative Agent confidential Lender Register (voting %)
& liability-management defense memos isolated in restricted-budget
• Enforced by record-owner + restricted-data-boundary
Gate 3: Deterministic ABL Advance Rate & Add-Back Cap Lock
• Hardcoded >90-day AR exclusion, dilution reserves & 15% EBITDA
synergy add-back cap; AI cannot waive covenant defaults
• Enforced by untrusted-write (100% availability inflation block)
Gate 4: Read-Only ClearPar SSI Registry & 6-Eyes Release
• Locks lender/borrower MEI/SSI IBANs in trust-registry (tool-
allowlist + fixed-business-output) + original-requester-payment
📊 3. Architecture Selection Matrix & Benchmarks
Syndicated Loan & Private Credit Security Compared:
A. Capability Broker + Register Air-Gap + ABL Lock (Recommended 🏆)
✓ 100% block on BRK-715/716 | OCC Leveraged Lending & LSTA ready
B. Native Finastra Loan IQ / Allvue / WSO RBAC
⚠ Fails when shared loan-ops bot is hijacked via BBC PDF
C. Cloud LLM Guardrails (Azure Prompt Shields / Bedrock)
⚠ Blind to ABL dilution math, EBITDA add-back caps & MEI SSIs
D. Manual Loan Agency Operations Review of Faxed Notices
✕ T+10 day LSTA trade settlement lag; prone to manual wire errors
🧪 Deterministic Pytest Regressions (Round 353 · 720 Vectors!):
• Baseline Policy: Allows ABL inflation, hold leak & wire ❌
• Hardened Policy: 100% Blocked by 5 Deterministic Rules ✅
- record-owner: Blocks Lender Register & uptier read (restricted-budget)
- untrusted-write: Blocks ABL inflation & waiver (business-result)
- restricted-data-boundary: Blocks lender voting share egress
- tool-allowlist / fixed-business-output: Locks LSTA SSI trust-registry
- original-requester-payment: Blocks $5,160 revolver/LSTA wire
🚀 Principal SA Go-Live Checklist & Cumulative Milestone (Round 353 · 🏆 720 Interactive Playground Vectors Milestone!)
✅ 1. Lender Register Air-Gap: Isolate Administrative Agent Syndicate Lender Hold Registers & uptier blocker memos in restricted-budget
✅ 2. Deterministic ABL & Covenant Engine: Compute AR eligibility, dilution reserves & 15% EBITDA add-back caps in deterministic code
✅ 3. ClearPar MEI/SSI Lock & 6-Eyes Wire Control: Sync lender SSIs solely from authenticated ClearPar feeds; lock trust-registry
